Package edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.decisions

package edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.decisions
This package contains classes related to decisions made by players in the game.

There are five types of decisions:
  • BuyDecision - a decision to buy a card
  • PlayCardDecision - a decision to play a card
  • GainCardDecision - a decision to gain a card
  • TrashCardDecision - a decision to trash (permanently remove from the player's deck) a card
  • EndPhaseDecision - a decision to end a phase of play


The Engine is responsible for creating lists of possible valid decisions, and prompting the Player to choose one. The Player is responsible for choosing a decision when prompted.
